events.title: CSS custom properties ship in Chrome 49
events.summary: Google shipped CSS custom properties in Chrome 49 on March 2, 2016 — native `--variable` syntax with the `var()` function for runtime theming.
events.about: CSS custom properties let authors define `--main-color: #06c` and reference it with `color: var(--main-color)` — unlike Sass variables, they cascade, inherit, and update at runtime via JavaScript `setProperty()`. Chrome 49 brought them to mainstream browsers, enabling dynamic themes without preprocessor rebuilds.

narrative.whyChosen: Native CSS variables closed the biggest gap between preprocessors and the platform.
narrative.whyImportant: Runtime-updatable variables enabled theming, design tokens, and responsive design without JavaScript frameworks.
narrative.problemSolved: Preprocessor variables were static — changing a theme required recompiling the entire stylesheet.

events.title: Samsung Galaxy S7 released
events.summary: Samsung began selling the Samsung Galaxy S7 — refined waterproof design and microSD return — solid iterative flagship.
events.about: The Galaxy S series remained Android's volume flagship counterweight to iPhone. Refined waterproof design and microsd return — solid iterative flagship. Developers testing Android builds routinely validated on Galaxy S hardware as the default non-Pixel reference.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy S7 continued Samsung's annual Android flagship cadence.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy S devices set the hardware bar millions of Android users and developers encounter.
narrative.problemSolved: Android needed consistent premium hardware for testing flagship features each year.

events.title: Demis Hassabis's AlphaGo defeats Lee Sedol 4–1
events.summary: DeepMind's AlphaGo beat Go champion Lee Sedol four games to one in Seoul on March 15, 2016 — a watershed moment for reinforcement learning watched by 200 million people.
events.about: Hassabis's team proved neural networks plus Monte Carlo tree search could master a game experts thought was a decade away from machine mastery. The victory reframed AI ambition from chess-scale search to intuition-like pattern recognition.

narrative.whyChosen: AlphaGo was the first AI victory that shocked both experts and the general public.
narrative.whyImportant: It proved deep RL could exceed human intuition in complex domains.
narrative.problemSolved: Go's combinatorial explosion had resisted brute-force and handcrafted AI for decades.

events.title: iPhone SE (1st gen) released
events.summary: Apple began selling the first iPhone SE on March 31, 2016 — packing iPhone 6S internals into the compact iPhone 5 body.
events.about: The SE kept a 4-inch screen alive for developers who still tested small-size-class layouts. It also offered a lower entry price for markets and users who wanted modern iOS without phablet dimensions.

narrative.whyChosen: The SE proved Apple would ship a modern small iPhone for holdouts and budget buyers.
narrative.whyImportant: A compact iOS device kept small-screen layout testing relevant for developers.
narrative.problemSolved: Users who wanted a small phone had to buy aging hardware or switch platforms.
